Shrouded in Mist#008.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: - {~}번째 기록: 늦잠. 사장이 언짢아하며 다음 주에 추가 근무를 시켰다.

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: 뭘? 지금 이 상황에 무슨 생각을-
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: 몰라, Yusanu! 다음에 뭘 할지? 우리가 어떻게- 어, 어떻게-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#022.dst: 할 수 있는 게 없어! 낯선 땅에 우리끼리 갇혔고, 가족도 친구도 다 잡혀갔거나, 아니- 더 나쁘게-
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#024.dst: 으! 그 녀석 말에 넘어가서 이걸... 이딴 걸 훔칠 가치가 있다고 믿다니! 안 훔쳤으면... 협상도 안 틀어지고, 이런 일도 없었을-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#025.dst: 감히 Rex 탓으로 돌리지 마. 그 군주가 한 말 들었잖아, 그놈들- 오, 오래전부터 우리 계획을 알고 있었다고!
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: 워워워워워! 자자, 다들 한 걸음씩 물러서죠?

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: 올빼미들! 물러서! 바로 폭력으로 뛰어드는 건 좀 성급하죠. 그건 대놓고 왕실 편인 놈들한테나 쓰는 거예요, 에헤헤.

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: 제 소개를 하죠! 이름은 Rurie, Canopy의 일원이자 올빼미 부대 대장이에요! 거칠게 굴어서 미안해요, 오늘 다들 좀 들떴나 봐요?
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: 질문, 질문! 유감이지만 우리 차례가 먼저예요. 올빼미들은 잠깐 물렸지만, 아직 풀려난 줄 알면 안 돼요, 아가씨!
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: ...대장님, 정말 괜찮겠습니까? 저들이 첩자일 수도 있습니다-
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: 아아아! 절차를 믿어요, 친구. 첩자든 아니든, 정보는 값지거든요.
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: 게다가! 우린 첩자를... 음, 다루는 법을 알잖아요. 위험 요소는 최소예요!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: 거기까지, 아저씨! 제 말 못 들었어요? 여기선 우리가 먼저 묻는다고요.
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: 아직 한마디도 안 한 건 당신뿐이네요! 자, 부끄러워 말고. 말해 봐요, 다들 어디서 왔죠?
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: 정말요? 꽤 먼 데서 왔네요? 거기서 여기까지 오는 건 꽤 큰일인데.
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: 아아! 이제 조각이 맞춰지네요! 이제 알겠어요.
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#044.dst: 오호호? 정말요? 아주, 아주 흥미롭네요. 아주아주 영리한 첩자든가, 아니면...
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#045.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#045.dst: 저... 저기! 들어! 너희가 누군지, 아니, 뭔지 모르겠지만-
Shrouded in Mist#045.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: 몇 번을 말해야 해요? 질문은 금지라고 했-
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#047.dst: 닥쳐! 우린 {p}에서 겨우 도망쳤어, 우리가- 우리가 여왕을 죽이려다가! 나머지 친구들은... 잡혔거나, 주, 죽었어!
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#048.dst: 그러니까- 그러니까 우릴 내버려 두든지, 아니면 내가- 네 소중한 사람들을 다, 다시는 못 보게 해 줄 거야!
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#053.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#053.dst: 그래요, 친구, 나도 딱 같은 생각이었어요. 자자, 새 친구들, 말이 사실이라면 Canopy가 도와줄 수 있을지도요!
Shrouded in Mist#053.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: 당신들 동료에 대한 정보가 있을지도 몰라요.
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#056.dst: 아- 하지만! 하지만 하지만 하지만, 봐요- {p}에선 신뢰가 곧 화폐예요. 비밀을 한꺼번에 다 털어놓을 순 없잖아요?
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: 그리고 우리 신뢰를 얻고 싶다면... 나 대신, 음, 몇 가지 일을 처리해 줘야겠어요.
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#059.dst: 아, 별로 어렵진 않아요... 조건이 하나 있어요! 한 명은 담보로 데려갈게요! 어느 것을 고를까요... 당신, 꼬마 아저씨!
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#061.dst: 그래요, 당신! 걱정 마요, 안전은 꼭 지켜 줄게요. 하지만... 뭐, 필요한 거 이해하죠?
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: 안 돼! 우린 더는... 더는 아무도 잃을 수 없어. 제발, 뭔가 다른 방법이-
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#063.dst: Sui... 괜... 찮아. 선택지가 없는 것 같아. 그냥... 저 사람들 말대로 해.
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: 세상에, 무슨 신파극이에요! 이봐요, 난 믿을 만한 사람이라고요! 나 때문에 걱정할 건 없어요.
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#067.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#067.dst: 멋져요! 합리적으로 나와 줘서 기뻐요. 그럼, 남은 둘은 군사 시설 세 곳을 망가뜨리고 와 줘야겠어요.
Shrouded in Mist#067.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: 자, 가서 작별 인사 하고, 나한테 목록 받으러 와요!
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: 야. 넌 괜찮을 거야. 나도 괜찮을 거고.
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: 적어도 지금은 믿어도 될 것 같아. 다른 방법이 있는 것도 아니고...
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: 우린 정말... 선택지가 없구나. 우린, 우린 저 사람들 도움이 필요해.
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: 눈물의 작별은 끝났나요? 훌륭해요. 정말이지, 이 너그러운 제안을 받아 줘서 기뻐요.
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#077.dst: 저쪽의 꼬마 친구는 걱정 마요! 우리 Canopy에서 무사히 지낼 테니까.
Shrouded in Mist#077.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#078.dst: ...당신을 어떻게 믿어? 그 애를... 해치지 않을 거라고?
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#079.dst: 아, 그게 바로 핵심 아니겠어요? 못 믿죠. 하지만 말했듯이, 이 숲에선 신뢰가 값져요. 그건 양쪽 다 마찬가지고요!
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: 자, 신참들! 망가뜨릴 시설 목록은 줬으니, 간단한 일일 거예요.
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: 그냥 어떻게든... 못 쓰게 만들어요! 방법은 솔직히 관심 없어요. 해내기만 하면 돼요!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: 그야, 절호의 기회니까요! 해야 할 일이 있고, 당신들은 스스로를 증명할 방법이 필요하잖아요...
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#084.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#084.dst: 그러니 안 할 이유가 없죠? 내 일이 줄어드니 불만은 없어요!
Shrouded in Mist#084.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: 신참! 딱 그거잖아요? 숲도 처음, 세상도 처음...
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: ...어쩌면 Fruma도 처음이려나? 아아, 그 놀란 표정 좀 지워요! 당신이 말 안 하면 나도 안 해요.
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: 다 끝나면 여기로 돌아와요! 너무 오래 걸리진 말고요? 심심한 건 싫거든요!
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: 그럼 안녕, 신참들! 행운을 빌어요! 충고 하나 하자면, 경계를 늦추지 마요. 안개 속에 뭐가 숨어 있을지 모르니까.
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: 아직 좀 헤매요? 퀘스트 북으로 부술 대상을 찾아봐요!
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: 그러니까 여기가... 거기? '군사... 감시탑...' 그런가 봐.
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#094.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#094.dst: 저 지지대들, 꽤 불안해 보이지 않아? 혹시...
Shrouded in Mist#094.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#095.dst: 그, 그것 좀 처리해 줄 수 있어?
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#098.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#100.dst: 책 좀 봐 줘, 다음엔 어디로 가?
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.

Shrouded in Mist#104.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#104.dst: 이건 같이 할 수 있을 것 같아. 가서, 음, 구조물의 약한 곳들을 터뜨려 줘. 난... 물길을 거꾸로 돌릴 수 있나 볼게.
Shrouded in Mist#104.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#105.dst: 그냥... 이 고철 덩어리를 치워 버리자.
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: 너, 음, 마법으로 약한 곳들을 터뜨려 봐.
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: 좋아, 그럼... 내 차례네. 음, 준비되면 말 걸어 줘.
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: 그래... 그래. 숨 쉬자. 난... 집중해야 해.
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: 그... 그, 음, 그 모든 일이 있은 뒤로, 난 계속... 내 저, 저주랑... 으. 무슨 말인지 알지?
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: 다... 다 너무 절망적이야! 우린 모두를 잃었고, 이젠- 이젠 Yusanu까지 잃었는데, 난... 아무것도 못 했어!
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#113.dst: 그리고 그 전에 마지막으로 한 게... 말다툼이라니! 지금 그 애는... 아마 무사하겠지만... 모르겠어. 싸우지 말 걸.
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#114.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#114.dst: 그- 그 일들을 떠올릴 때마다 너무... 화가 나! 그러면 내 주변의 소용돌이치는 바다가 점점 더 거세지고, 그리고... 그리고...
Shrouded in Mist#114.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: 무서워, {u}. Mora가... Syndra가... Rex, Zeph, Steel Feather 모두- 다 걱정돼! 그런데 난... 아무것도 할 수가 없어...
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: 만약... 만약 다 사라졌으면? 그럼, 그럼, 영원히 우리뿐이면...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: 아... 알아, {u}, 안다고! 나도... 노력하고 있잖아?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: 나한테, 하, 힘이 남아 있을지 모르겠어. 다... 너무 빨라...
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: 난... 이런 거 원한 적 없어. 난 그냥... 그냥 살고 싶었을 뿐인데...
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: 휴... 좋아. Sui, 집중해. 할 수 있어.
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#124.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#125.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#125.dst: 그게... 바다가, 멈췄어. 잡아당겼더니... 움직임이 멈췄어, 그리고...
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: 지금은... 지금은 그, 그걸 생각할 때가 아니야. 됐으니까... 그걸로 됐어.
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: 그냥... 책 좀 봐 줘, 다음은 어디야?
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: 이... 이게 마지막 같아. Rurie한테 가서, 음, 끝났다고 하자.
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: 튼튼해... 보여. 음, 그냥 부수기는... 힘들겠어. 다른 방법을 찾아야 해...
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: 그, 근처에 물이 없어. 그러니까, 그러니까 병사들이 나타나면... 제발, 처리해 줄래?
Shrouded in Mist#132.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: 하, 파괴 공작원이군! 왕실 재산을 망가뜨리고 무사할 줄 알았나? 내가 지키는 한 어림없다!
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: 음... 잘했어, {u}. 조종 장치를 부술 생각은 못 했어...
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#136.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#136.dst: 그게 마지막이었나? Rurie한테 돌아가서... 끝났다고 말하자.
Shrouded in Mist#136.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: 이런 이런! 신참들이 돌아왔네요! 말해 봐요, 시험은 어땠어요?
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: 시킨 대로 했어, 그러니까... 이제 친구들 얘기나 해!
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: 아아아! 서두르지 마요! 유감이지만 아직 안 끝났어요!
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: 유감스럽게도 진지해요! 그건, 친구들, 임무의 첫 부분일 뿐이었죠.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#143.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#143.dst: 오, 오히려 반대예요! 일을 끝내자마자 바로 소식을 받았거든요.
Shrouded in Mist#143.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#145.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#145.dst: 하지만 돼요. 우리 도움을 원하면 시키는 대로 해요. 위안이 될지 모르지만, 거래를 마치기 전 마지막 부탁이에요.
Shrouded in Mist#145.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: 부디... 음, {p} 주민 하나를 여기로 옮겨 줬으면 해요. 다른 사람 눈에 띄지 않게 조심하고요! 그러면... 문제가 생기거든요.
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#148.dst: 그... 그 사람이 우릴 기다리고 있어?
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#149.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#149.dst: 아! 다시 말할게요. 납치해 오라는 거예요.
Shrouded in Mist#149.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: 네, 바로 그거예요! 납치해서 여기로 데려오면, 나머진 우리가 처리해요.
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: 그냥... 그냥 집에서 아무 주민이나 낚아채 오라고? 그리고, 그리고 '나머지 처리'는 무슨 뜻이야?
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: 질문은 금지예요, 아가씨! 친구가 무사하길 바란다면 말이죠.
Shrouded in Mist#153.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#155.dst: 누굴 찾아야 하는지도 말 안 했잖아!
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: 아하하, 미안해요, 내 실수! Nisen이라는 남자를 찾으면 돼요. 여기로 데려와요, 너무 오래 끌지 말고!
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: Nisen. 좋아. {u}, 우리... 동굴 밖에서 얘기하자.
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#160.dst: 이건... 이건 정말 말도 안 돼.
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: 우린, 우린 Yusanu를 되찾고... 여기서 빠져나갈 방법을 찾아야 해.
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#162.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#162.dst: 알아, 알아, 안다고! 그런데 찾기 시작하면 저 사람들이, 저 사람들이 눈치챌 거야.
Shrouded in Mist#162.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: 난... 그 광대 명령 따르는 거 지긋지긋해. 근데 네 말이 맞아...
Shrouded in Mist#163.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#164.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#164.dst: 그냥... 이상해. 이 마지막 임무. 이해가 안 돼.
Shrouded in Mist#164.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: Rurie가 제정신이 아니라 해도... 무고한 사람을 그냥- 그냥 죽일 것 같진 않아. 게다가 저 사람들은, 음, 저항군이잖아.
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: 으. 모르겠어. 그 Nisen이란 사람을 조사하면... Rurie의 속셈을 알 수 있을지도.
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#168.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#170.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#170.dst: 휴. 여기 올라오는 거 정말 쉽지 않네... Auburn의 Red Fox는, 하, 비교도 안 돼.
Shrouded in Mist#170.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#171.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#171.dst: Nisen에 대해 알아보려고 했는데... 사람들이 날 별로 안 좋아하나 봐.
Shrouded in Mist#171.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#172.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#187.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#187.dst: ...안... 보이는데요. 그거 없으시- 어. 저. 그러니까. 아무것도. 아뇨. 절대, 어... 절대 아니에요.
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#188.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#188.dst: 못 보겠어요, 원래 당신이랑 말하면 안 되는데, 잠깐, 그것도 해당되나 으악!
Shrouded in Mist#188.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#189.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#189.dst: ...저. 저는. 당신. ...으, 이런 거 정말 못 해요.
Shrouded in Mist#189.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: ...음. ...죄송해요. Nisen은... 저. 알긴 알아요. 말하면 안 되지만 알아요. 제발 해치지 마세요.
Shrouded in Mist#190.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: 북서쪽 짚라인을 타세요. 위로 올라가는 거 말고요.
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#195.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#195.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Nisen의 집에서 그에 대한 단서를 찾으세요

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: 이상하네... 마지막 기록이 몇 주 전 날짜야.
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: 힉! 분명 Nisen이야! 핑계를 생각해야 해...
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#202.dst: 실례지만? 제 거처에서 뭘 하고 계십니까?
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: 제가 틀리지 않았다면, 남의 거처에 불쑥 들어오는 풍습은 없을 텐데요.
Shrouded in Mist#203.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#204.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#204.dst: 아... 저, 정말 죄송해요! 저, 저희- 저희는 여기가... 빵집인 줄 알았어요.
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#206.dst: 아. 네, 건물을 잘못 찾으셨군요. 빵집은 아래 지상층에 있습니다.
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: 아! 길 알려 주셔서 감사해요. 오해해서... 정말 죄송해요.
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: 큰일 날 뻔했다... 난, 음, 그 사람이 믿어서 놀랐어.
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: 다, 당황했단 말이야! 그래도 통했잖아, 안 그래?
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: 그 사람... 의외로 말이 많더라. 다른 사람들이랑 비교하면 반가운 변화지.
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: 그런데, 음, 좀... 이상했어. 자기 대답에 확신이 없어 보였어...
Shrouded in Mist#213.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: 모르겠어. 넌 어떻게 생각해? 짐작 가는 거 있어?
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: 나도... 같은 생각이었어. 그러면 일기가 갑자기 끊긴 것도 설명돼...
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: 어쩌면... 그럴 수도 있겠네. 내가 섣불리 단정하는 걸지도 몰라.
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#217.dst: 어... 그건 좀 더 다듬어 보자.
Shrouded in Mist#217.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#218.dst: 봐, 그 사람 침대 옆 탁자에서 일정표를 하나 슬쩍했어.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#219.dst: 들어 봐. '정오에 무기 대장장이의 사냥 도구를 남쪽 출구로 배달할 것.'
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#220.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#220.dst: 이상하지? 그 사람 분명 뭔가 수상해... 그래도 납치해서 웬... 웬 새 인간한테 넘기다니! 마음에 안 들어.
Shrouded in Mist#220.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#221.dst: 하지만... 선택지가 별로 없어. 남문 밖에서 진 치고 기다리자...
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#226.dst: 난... 하, 여기서 계속 역부족이라고 느꼈어. 그 사람들... 음, 도움 없이 이렇게 많은 걸 해 본 적이 없거든.
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#227.dst: 그래도... 네가 도와주니까. 음. 고마워- 곁에 있어 줘서. 난... 너 없었으면 여기까지 못 왔을 거야.
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: 음... 그래도 통한 것 같아. 좀 도와줄래?
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#233.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: 그냥, 음, 그 사람 위에 떨어졌달까? 그리고... 이렇게 됐어.
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: 우린... 슬슬 움직여야 해. 누가- 누가 보면 안 돼!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: 음! 조종이란 말은... 좀 아닌 것 같아. 난... 하, 얼리려고 했거든. 그러니까... 아직 연습 중이야. 아마도.
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: 음! 난... 그건 생각 못 했어.
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#239.dst: 이런 이런, 신참들! 손이 좀 필요해 보이네요!
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#240.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#240.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: 그야, 나무 위에서죠! 선량한 Nisen 씨를 제압했군요, 잘했어요, 잘했어.
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: ...시키는 건 다 했어. 이제- 이제 아는 거 말해!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#243.dst: 오, 이런, 둘 다 끝난 줄 알았어요? 하! 아하하하!
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: 농담! 농담이에요, 농담- 세상에, 그 표정들 좀 봐! 친구끼리 장난 좀 칠 수 있잖아요?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: 농담은 그만할게요... 일단은. 좋은 소식! 시험에 통과했어요!
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: 네, 네, 진정해요, 말해 줄게요. 잠깐만요! 세상에. 참 성미도 급하네요?
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#250.dst: 둘을 Canopy로 데려갈게요! 하지만, 음, 작은 예방책이 하나- 도착할 때까지 눈을 가려야 해요. 보안 조치일 뿐이에요!
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#251.dst: 으... 있잖아, 이제 신경도 안 써. 그냥... Yusanu한테 데려가.
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: Rurie, 해명해 볼래요? 왜 이 외부인들을 여기로 데려왔죠?
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: 아, 알잖아요, Fuhue! 오늘 아침 순찰이 너무너무 지루했다고요! 다들 분위기 메이커는 아니잖아요..
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#257.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#257.dst: Azael이 모집에 관해 규칙을 확실히 정한 거 알잖아요. 필요한 서류는 제출했어요? 제 책상엔 그런 게 하나도 없던데요.
Shrouded in Mist#257.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: 그... 아, 서류가 진짜였어요? 난 늘 당신이 재미로 지어낸 건 줄 알았는데.
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: 아니요. 규정이 있는 데는 이유가 있어요, Rurie 대장. 직접 시간 내서 검토할래요, 아니면 Cileon 대장한테 설명하라고 할까요?
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: 네, 네, 중요한 건 알아요- 그런데 Cileon도 규정에 대해선 나랑 생각이 같을걸요. 그렇죠, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: 야, 야! 우리가 여기 없는 것처럼, 없는 것처럼 굴지 마!
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: Cileon! 그것도 규정 위반이에요. 왕실이 찾을 시체를 남기면 안 되죠, 훨씬 간단한 처리 방법이 있잖아요.
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: 그리고 물론, 먼저 필요한 정보를 고문해서 다 뽑아내야 하고요. 이 말만 열두 번은 들었다고요.
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: 아! 듣고 있었군요! 좋아요, Rurie 대장. 언젠가 정신 차리게 해 줄게요.
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: 아까 꼬마 사슴들에게 Nisen을 처리실로 데려가라고 했어요. 수고했어요, 대장.
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#267.dst: 아, 별거 아니에요! 땀 한 방울 안 흘렸는걸요!
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#268.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#268.dst: 자, 나중에 봐요! 규정을 따르려면 이 애들을 Azael한테 넘겨야겠네요.
Shrouded in Mist#268.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#269.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#269.dst: 자자, 친구들! 목이 좀 말라서 이만 가 볼게요! Azael은 알아서 찾을 수 있겠죠?
Shrouded in Mist#269.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#270.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#271.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#271.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: 일정은 늘 빽빽한데... 이제 처리할 게 더 늘었네요.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: 그래도 질문 몇 개 받을 시간은 낼 수 있겠죠.
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#283.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#283.dst: 사슴 쪽 작전만이 아니라 Canopy 전체의 관리도 맡고 있어요.
Shrouded in Mist#283.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: Azael 님은 오두막에 계세요... 여기서 바로 남서쪽이에요.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#287.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#287.dst: 하지만 자기 일에는 놀랍도록 재능이 있어요. 올빼미 부대를 그만큼 이끌 사람은 없죠.
Shrouded in Mist#287.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: 아니면 못 보거나요! 남을지 말지는 Azael 님이 정해요. 그분에게 좋은 인상을 남기길 바라요.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: 지금까지 {p}에서 너희가 한 일은 들었다. 아주 인상적이구나.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: 말 끊어서 미안하지만, 우린 종일 뛰어다녀서 피곤해. Yusanu는 어디 있어?
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: 그래, 마침내 재회했구나. 하지만 이제 왔으니 본론으로 들어가자.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#297.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#297.dst: 그리고 우리의 목적이 같아 보이는구나... 왕실을 무너뜨리는 것. 우리 Canopy는 이를 위해 매우 적극적으로 움직여 왔다.
Shrouded in Mist#297.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: 우린 세 부대를 두었고, 각자 맡은 책임이 있다. 부대마다 다른 전선에서 왕실을 공격하지.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: 올빼미 부대는 우리의 눈과 귀다. 가장 뛰어난 암살자들이기도 하지. 이미 만나 본 Rurie 대장은 우리 중 가장 치명적인 이 중 하나다.
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: 여우 부대는 우리의 돌격대다. {p} 고유의 기술을 쓰는 숙련된 검사들이지. 결투에서 절대 지지 않도록 훈련받았다.
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: 사슴 부대는 우리의 지휘대, 작전의 두뇌다. {p} 안의 첩자를... 처리하는 일도 맡고 있지.
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: 첩자다. 너희가 데려온 그 남자, Nisen... 유감이지만 더는 Nisen이 아니다. 몇 주 전, 왕실의 정예 첩자와 바꿔치기됐지. 우린 그들을 변신자라 부른다.
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: {p}은(는) 수년간 이 변장의 달인들에게 시달려 왔다. 정체가 드러나면 붙잡아 심문을 위해 가둬 두지.
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: 이 지역 사람들은 신원을 증명할 방법을 만들었다. 바로 메달이다. 메달이 없으면 많은 이가 너와 말도 섞지 않을 거다.
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: 음... Azael 님, 무례하게 굴려는 건 아니지만... Rurie가 Roughworks 친구들 소식이 있다고 했어요.
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: 어떤 의미로는 있다. 하지만 올빼미들이 축제에서 가져온 정보를 아직 정리하는 중이다. 지금은 줄 수 있는 게 없구나.
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: 안심해라, 모두 검토하고 나면 아무것도 숨기지 않겠다.
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#309.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#309.dst: 너희 친구들의 소식을 계속 찾겠다고 약속하마.
Shrouded in Mist#309.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#310.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#310.dst: 이제... 이제야 겨우 숨 돌릴 틈이 생긴 것 같아.
Shrouded in Mist#310.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#311.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#311.dst: 난 Yusanu랑 같이 여기서 정보 정리가 끝나길 기다릴게.
Shrouded in Mist#311.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#312.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#312.dst: 난 이 장치가 어디에 쓰이는 건지 알아내는 데 집중할게.
